name: @activepieces/piece-iloveapi
description: Compress, merge, split, convert, OCR, watermark, protect and sign PDFs and images using iLovePDF / iLoveIMG / iLoveSign.

auth.description:
To get your project public key:

1. Sign up or log in at https://developer.ilovepdf.com/
2. Open your project on the developer dashboard
3. Copy the **Project public key** (starts with `project_public_`)
4. Paste it here

Only the public key is required. Tokens are issued automatically per request.

compress_pdf.name: compress_pdf
compress_pdf.description: Reduce the size of a PDF file using iLoveAPI.

output_filename.description: Output file name without extension. Use {date}, {n} or {filename} placeholders.

packaged_filename.description: Name of the ZIP archive when the result contains multiple files. No extension.

aiMetadata.description: Shrink a PDF file size, choosing a compression level: "extreme" for the smallest file at lower quality, "recommended" for a balanced result (default), or "low" for the largest file at best quality. Each run produces a new compressed file.

merge_pdf.name: merge_pdf
merge_pdf.description: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document, in the order provided.

files.description: List of PDF files to merge. The output preserves the listed order.

output_filename.description: Output file name without extension. Use {date}, {n} or {filename} placeholders.

packaged_filename.description: Name of the ZIP archive when the result contains multiple files. No extension.

aiMetadata.description: Concatenate two or more PDF files into one document, preserving the order in which they are listed. Requires at least two input files. Each run generates a new merged file, so re-running does not deduplicate against earlier outputs.

split_pdf.name: split_pdf
split_pdf.description: Split a PDF by page ranges, fixed page batches, removed pages, or target file size.

ranges.description: Used with mode "Page Ranges". Example: "1-5,7,10-13". Each range becomes a separate PDF.

fixed_range.description: Used with mode "Fixed Range". Number of pages per output PDF (e.g. 1 splits into one PDF per page).

remove_pages.description: Used with mode "Remove Pages". Pages to delete, e.g. "2,4-6". The remaining pages stay in one PDF.

filesize.description: Used with mode "By File Size". Maximum size in megabytes per output PDF.

merge_after.displayName: Merge results back into one PDF
merge_after.description: When enabled, merges the split outputs into a single PDF.

output_filename.description: Output file name without extension. Use {date}, {n} or {filename} placeholders.

packaged_filename.description: Name of the ZIP archive when the result contains multiple files. No extension.

aiMetadata.description: Split one PDF into multiple PDFs via the iLoveAPI service. Pick this to break a document apart by explicit page ranges, fixed batches of N pages, by removing specific pages, or by a maximum output file size (MB) — the split mode determines which range/size input is required. Optionally merge the pieces back into a single PDF. Each call produces new output files, so repeated runs are not idempotent.

pdf_to_jpg.name: pdf_to_jpg
pdf_to_jpg.description: Convert PDF pages to JPG images, or extract images embedded in the PDF.

options.label: Render each page as a JPG

output_filename.description: Output file name without extension. Use {date}, {n} or {filename} placeholders.

packaged_filename.description: Name of the ZIP archive when the result contains multiple files. No extension.

aiMetadata.description: Turn a PDF into JPG images. Choose the "pages" mode to render each page as a full JPG, or the "extract" mode to pull out only the raster images already embedded inside the PDF. Each run produces a new converted output, so re-running creates a fresh result rather than reusing a prior one.

jpg_to_pdf.name: jpg_to_pdf

output_filename.description: Output file name without extension. Use {date}, {n} or {filename} placeholders.

packaged_filename.description: Name of the ZIP archive when the result contains multiple files. No extension.

aiMetadata.description: Convert one or more JPG/PNG images into PDF, with control over orientation, page size, and margin. By default all images are merged into a single PDF; disable "Merge into single PDF" to instead get one PDF per image. Each run produces new output rather than reusing a prior result.

output_filename.description: Output file name without extension. Use {date}, {n} or {filename} placeholders.

packaged_filename.description: Name of the ZIP archive when the result contains multiple files. No extension.

aiMetadata.description: Convert a single Office document (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP, RTF, or TXT) into a PDF. Use this when the source is an Office/text file; for images use JPG to PDF and for web pages use HTML to PDF. Each run produces a new converted file.

html_to_pdf.name: html_to_pdf

url.description: Public URL of the web page to render as PDF.

output_filename.description: Output file name without extension. Use {date}, {n} or {filename} placeholders.

Use Office to PDF or JPG to PDF instead when the source is a local file rather than a live web page. Each run produces a new output.

ocr_pdf.name: ocr_pdf

ocr_languages.description: ISO 639-2 language codes (e.g. eng, fra, deu, spa, ita, por, rus, chi_sim, jpn, ara). Defaults to English.

output_filename.description: Output file name without extension. Use {date}, {n} or {filename} placeholders.

packaged_filename.description: Name of the ZIP archive when the result contains multiple files. No extension.

aiMetadata.description: Add a searchable, selectable text layer to a scanned or image-only PDF via OCR, defaulting to English when no language is given (accepts one or more ISO 639-2 codes such as eng, fra, deu, chi_sim). Use this before extracting or searching text in scanned documents. Each run produces a new output file.

watermark_pdf.name: watermark_pdf
watermark_pdf.description: Stamp a text or image watermark across pages of a PDF.

image.description: Required when mode is "Image". JPG/PNG image used as the watermark.

pages.description: Pages to apply watermark to. Use "all", a single page, or ranges like "1-3,5".

output_filename.description: Output file name without extension. Use {date}, {n} or {filename} placeholders.

packaged_filename.description: Name of the ZIP archive when the result contains multiple files. No extension.

aiMetadata.description: Overlay a watermark onto chosen pages of a PDF. Each run writes a new watermarked file rather than reusing a previous result.

output_filename.description: Output file name without extension. Use {date}, {n} or {filename} placeholders.

packaged_filename.description: Name of the ZIP archive when the result contains multiple files. No extension.

output_filename.description: Output file name without extension. Use {date}, {n} or {filename} placeholders.

create_signature_request.name: create_signature_request
create_signature_request.description: Send one or more PDF documents for electronic signature, with custom signers and signature placeholders.

signers.description: People who will receive the document.

phone.description: International format including country code, e.g. +14155550100.

access_code.description: Extra code the signer must enter before opening the document.

elements.description: Placeholders to drop on each PDF page. Match them to signers by email. If empty, iLovePDF will let signers place fields freely.

signer_email.description: Email matching one of the signers above.

position.description: Either a gravity keyword like "bottom right" or coordinates "X Y" (PDF origin is bottom-left; use negative Y to measure from top).

pages.description: Pages to drop this element on, e.g. "1" or "1-3" or "all".

size.description: Font size or element height. Defaults to 14 for text, 50 for signature.

content.description: Static text (for type "text") or default value (for "input" / "date").

color.description: Hex color for text elements, e.g. #000000.

brand_name.description: Sender name shown in the email and signing page.

subject_signer.description: Subject line for the signature invitation email.

message_signer.description: Body for the signature invitation email.

expiration_days.description: Days until the request expires. 1 to 130. Default 120.

lock_order.description: When enabled, signers receive the document one at a time in the listed order.

signer_reminders.description: Send reminder emails to signers who have not yet signed.

certified.description: Apply a certified-signature seal to the final PDF.

aiMetadata.description: Start an electronic signature request: upload one or more PDFs and define the signers (by name and email, each as signer, validator, or viewer) plus optional field placeholders matched to signers by email. Returns a requester token used by the status, reminder, void, expiration, and download actions. Each call creates a brand-new request and dispatches invitation emails, so it is not idempotent.

get_signature_status.name: get_signature_status
get_signature_status.description: Look up the current status of a signature request, including each signer.

token_requester.description: The "token_requester" returned when the signature request was created.

aiMetadata.description: Look up the current status of a signature request by its requester token, including the per-signer state. Read-only and safe to poll repeatedly; use this to check whether a request is completed before downloading signed files or the audit trail.

send_signer_reminder.name: send_signer_reminder
send_signer_reminder.description: Email a reminder to signers who have not yet completed the signature. Limited to 2 calls per day.

aiMetadata.description: Send a manual nudge email to outstanding signers of an existing signature request, identified by its requester token. Each call sends a fresh reminder (not idempotent) and the provider caps this at 2 calls per day per request; for scheduled automatic reminders configure them on the request itself at creation time instead.

void_signature.name: void_signature
void_signature.description: Cancel an in-progress signature request. The document becomes inaccessible to all signers.

token_requester.description: The "token_requester" of the signature request to void.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently cancel an in-progress signature request by its requester token, after which the document can no longer be signed and becomes inaccessible to every signer. This is a destructive, irreversible state change; calling it again on an already-voided request has no further effect.

increase_expiration_days.name: increase_expiration_days
increase_expiration_days.description: Extend the expiration of a signature request by a number of days. Total cannot exceed 130 days from now.

days.description: Number of days to add. Must be between 1 and 130.

aiMetadata.description: Push back the expiration date of an existing signature request (by requester token) by a given number of days, where the added amount must be 1 to 130 and the resulting total cannot exceed 130 days from now. Not idempotent: each call adds days on top of the current expiration rather than setting it to an absolute date.

download_signed_files.name: download_signed_files
download_signed_files.description: Download the signed PDF (or ZIP if multiple files). The signature must be in "completed" status.

token_requester.description: The "token_requester" of the completed signature request.

file_name.description: Name to store the downloaded file under. Defaults to "signed-{token}.pdf".

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve the finished signed document for a signature request by its requester token, returning a single PDF or a ZIP when several files were signed. The request must already be in "completed" status (check first with Get Signature Status); for the evidence log use Download Audit Trail. Read-only retrieval, safe to repeat.

download_audit_trail.name: download_audit_trail
download_audit_trail.description: Download the audit-trail PDF for a completed signature request. Useful for compliance and dispute resolution.

token_requester.description: The "token_requester" of the completed signature request.

file_name.description: Name to store the audit PDF under. Defaults to "audit-{token}.pdf".

aiMetadata.description: Fetch the audit-trail PDF (the legal evidence/event log) for a completed signature request, identified by its requester token, for compliance and dispute resolution. Read-only retrieval, safe to repeat; to get the actual signed documents use Download Signed Files instead.

task_completed.name: task_completed
task_completed.description: Fires when a processing task finishes successfully. Optionally filter by tool.

instructions.description:
**How to connect**

1. Sign in to https://developer.ilovepdf.com/ and open your project.
2. Go to **Webhooks** and click **Add Webhook**.
3. Paste the URL below into **Endpoint URL**:

```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```

4. In **Events**, select **Task Completed (task.completed)**.
5. Save the webhook. The trigger will fire on every matching event.

tools.description: Optional. When set, only fires for tasks using one of the selected tools. Leave empty to fire for every tool.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an iLoveAPI processing task completes successfully (the task.completed webhook event). The event payload represents the finished task, including its tool and result details. Optionally scoped to specific tools via the tools filter so only completions from those tools trigger the flow.

nl.Compress, merge, split, convert, OCR, wa: Compress, samenvoegen, splitsen, converteren, converteren, OCR, watermerk, beschermen en ondertekenen van PDF's en afbeeldingen met behulp van iLovePDF / iLoveIMG / iLoveSign.
Om uw openbare sleutel van uw project te verkrijgen:

1. Meld u aan of log in op https://developer. lovepdf.com/
2. Open uw project op het ontwikkelaarsdashboard
3. Kopieer de **openbare projectsleutel** (begint met `project_public_`)
4. Plak het hier

Alleen de publieke sleutel is vereist. Tokens worden automatisch uitgegeven per aanvraag.
nl.Reduce the size of a PDF file using iLov: Verminder het formaat van een PDF-bestand met behulp van iLoveAPI.
nl.Combine multiple PDF files into a single: Combineer meerdere PDF-bestanden in een enkel document, in de opgegeven volgorde.
nl.Split a PDF by page ranges, fixed page b: Splits een PDF per pagina-bereik, vaste pagina-batches, verwijderde pagina's of doelbestandsgrootte.
nl.Convert PDF pages to JPG images, or extr: Converteer PDF-pagina's naar JPG-afbeeldingen, of pak afbeeldingen in de PDF.
nl.Convert one or more images (JPG/PNG) int: Converteer één of meer afbeeldingen (JPG/PNG) naar een PDF-document.
nl.Convert Office documents (DOCX, XLSX, PP: Converteer Office documenten (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, etc.) naar PDF.
nl.Convert a publicly accessible web page U: Converteer een publiekelijk toegankelijke webpagina-URL naar een PDF.
nl.Run OCR on a PDF to make scanned documen: Start OCR op een PDF om gescande documenten doorzoekbaar te maken. Ondersteunt 100+ talen.
nl.Stamp a text or image watermark across p: Zet een tekst of afbeelding watermerk over pagina's van een PDF.
Voeg een wachtwoord toe aan een PDF-document.
nl.Remove the password from a PDF (you must: Verwijder het wachtwoord uit een PDF (u moet het huidige wachtwoord kennen).
nl.Stamp page numbers onto a PDF, with cont: Zet paginanummers op een PDF, met controle over positie en stijl.
nl.Rotate every page of a PDF by 90, 180, o: Draai elke pagina van een PDF met 90, 180 of 270 graden.
nl.Extract plain or detailed text (with pos: Haal platte of gedetailleerde tekst (met posities en lettertype metadata) uit een PDF.
nl.Attempt to fix a damaged or corrupted PD: Poging een beschadigd of beschadigd PDF-bestand op te lossen.
nl.Send one or more PDF documents for elect: Stuur een of meer PDF-documenten voor elektronische handtekening, met eigen borden en aanduidingen van handtekeningen.
nl.Look up the current status of a signatur: Zoek de huidige status van een handtekeningsverzoek, inclusief elke ondertekenaar.
nl.Email a reminder to signers who have not: Email een herinnering aan ondertekenaars die de handtekening nog niet hebben voltooid. Beperkt tot 2 oproepen per dag.
Annuleer een in-progress signature request. Het document wordt niet toegankelijk voor alle signers.
nl.Extend the expiration of a signature req: Verleng de verlooptijd van een handtekeningaanvraag met een aantal dagen. Totaal kan niet langer zijn dan 130 dagen.
nl.Download the signed PDF (or ZIP if multi: Download de ondertekende PDF (of ZIP als meerdere bestanden). De handtekening moet de status "voltooid" hebben.
nl.Download the audit-trail PDF for a compl: Download de audit-trail PDF voor een voltooide handtekeningsverzoek. Nuttig voor naleving en geschillenoplossing.
nl.Merge results back into one PDF: Samenvoegen van resultaten terug naar één PDF
nl.Output file name without extension. Use: Uitvoer bestandsnaam zonder extensie. Gebruik {date}, {n} of {filename} aanduidingen.
nl.Name of the ZIP archive when the result: Naam van het ZIP-archief wanneer het resultaat meerdere bestanden bevat. Geen extensie.
nl.List of PDF files to merge. The output p: Lijst van te samenvoegen PDF-bestanden. De uitvoer bewaart de vermelde order.
nl.Used with mode \"Page Ranges\". Example:: Gebruikt met modus "Paginabereiken". Voorbeeld: "1-5,7.10-13". Elk bereik wordt een afzonderlijke PDF.
nl.Used with mode \"Fixed Range\". Number o: Gebruikt met modus "Vaste bereik". Aantal pagina's per output (bv. 1 splits in één PDF per pagina)
nl.Used with mode \"Remove Pages\". Pages t: Gebruikt met de modus "Pagina's verwijderen". Pagina's om te verwijderen, bijvoorbeeld "2,4-6". De resterende pagina's blijven in één PDF.
nl.Used with mode \"By File Size\". Maximum: Gebruikt met modus "Per Bestandsgrootte". Maximale grootte in megabytes per output PDF.
nl.When enabled, merges the split outputs i: Wanneer ingeschakeld, voegt de split-outputs samen tot één enkele PDF.
Afbeeldingen om in de PDF op te nemen.
Pagina marge in pixels rond elke afbeelding. Standaard 0.
nl.When enabled (default), produces one PDF: Indien ingeschakeld (standaard), produceert één PDF voor alle afbeeldingen. Indien uitgeschakeld, produceert één PDF per afbeelding.

pt.Compress, merge, split, convert, OCR, wa: Comprimento, fundir, dividir, converter, OCR, marca d'água, proteja e assine PDFs e imagens usando iLovePDF / iLoveIMG / iLoveSign.

1. Sign up or log in at https://developer.ilovepdf.com/
2. Open your project on the developer dashboard
3. Copy the **Project public key** (starts with `project_public_`)
4. Paste it here
